hypothesis.hypothesis: FEED-002 representation claims can be separated into exact algebraic facts, source-specific structure and untested cryptographic interpretations.

parameters.field: all 29 residues; enumerate y=0..28 for each x=0..28
parameters.matrix: LP1/05 only, all eight square symmetries, compare all 25 positions
parameters.prime_mapping: all 29 GP entries, compare full values versus residues modulo 29
parameters.lp2_control: LP2/56 only; original offset=0 shift=1 skip=56 held fixed; compare position-stream phi(prime) with phi(GP[cipher_index])

hypothesis.scorer: none; exact finite arithmetic and rune-reference equality
hypothesis.success: All nonzero field residues have one inverse and zero has none; original matrix is centrosymmetric; the existing position stream agrees with independently counted totients; rune-value-based alternative has at least one exact-reference mismatch.
hypothesis.failure: A completed alternative mismatch is a negative only for the listed page/parameters. A failed expected arithmetic check is recorded as a negative audit; exceptions/timeouts are separate execution statuses.
hypothesis.limits: Finite-field availability is not evidence of multiplication in LP; mapped symmetries are not independent observations; no p-values, no author-intent inference, no corpus scan.
hypothesis.next_step: Before any unsolved-page survey, freeze page/transcription versions, symmetry/statistic definitions, transformation deduplication, null controls and multiple-testing criteria.
